title: Evidence recovery for completed Holo HRR T=512 CPU run
hypothesis: The completed public-corpus T=512 training run can be deterministically verified and finalized from its captured result artifact after the original envelope's schema error is isolated.
rationale: The v2 experiment executed all three arms to completion under the frozen configuration, but its wrapper emitted extra top-level metadata and ilXyr correctly rejected the run envelope. This recovery experiment verifies the captured result SHA-256, frozen configuration, upstream commit, source-file hashes, and CPU device, then records the already-completed training result without rerunning or changing the computation.

metrics.name: execution_complete
metrics.description: The frozen result-recovery verifier exited successfully and emitted a complete metrics envelope, encoded as 0 or 1.

metrics.name: source_clean
metrics.description: The verifier confirmed the pinned upstream source and captured run artifact, encoded as 0 or 1.

metrics.name: softmax_final_val_bpb
metrics.description: Softmax arm final validation bits per byte from the completed training run; lower is better.

metrics.name: hrr_final_val_bpb
metrics.description: Uniform HRR arm final validation bits per byte from the completed training run; lower is better.

metrics.name: gated_final_val_bpb
metrics.description: Gated HRR arm final validation bits per byte from the completed training run; lower is better.

metrics.name: softmax_median_ms_per_step
metrics.description: Softmax arm median training-step wall time.

metrics.name: hrr_median_ms_per_step
metrics.description: Uniform HRR arm median training-step wall time.

metrics.name: gated_median_ms_per_step
metrics.description: Gated HRR arm median training-step wall time.

metrics.name: hrr_minus_softmax_bpb
metrics.description: Uniform HRR final validation bits per byte minus softmax; negative favors HRR.

metrics.name: gated_minus_softmax_bpb
metrics.description: Gated HRR final validation bits per byte minus softmax; negative favors gated HRR.

metrics.name: hrr_speedup_vs_softmax
metrics.description: Softmax median milliseconds per step divided by uniform HRR median milliseconds per step; above 1 favors HRR.

metrics.name: gated_speedup_vs_softmax
metrics.description: Softmax median milliseconds per step divided by gated HRR median milliseconds per step; above 1 favors gated HRR.
